# Retire the main-thread DragDrop park surface nothing calls

## Context

#19538 retires the worker-side pointer-path vessel conversion and park (docking design record §2.8.6, amended for #19533: a pointer drag never parks). Its PR also removes the last worker callers of the main-thread `DragDrop` addon's park surface:
- the pointer park called `parkWindowDrag`;
- the native re-show (`NativeVesselTransaction.effectsFor().reshowVessel`) asked `resumeWindowDrag` and the orphan-recovery probe and acknowledgement before the route move. Only a parked pointer drag could ever answer them, so they always fell through.

Once #19538 merges, that surface in `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs` has no caller.

## The Problem

About 965 lines of main-thread code still read as live:
- `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs` lines 1069–2034 at `5698517f19`;
- the park helpers at lines 490–558;
- the parked branches of the kept methods.

Every reader of the addon has to reason about a parked window drag, its recovery and its orphan-recovery serialization. `test/playwright/unit/main/addon/DragDrop.spec.mjs` keeps 104 references pinning that machinery. The addon is also the file-size ratchet's over-target entry (1,294 code lines).

## The Architectural Reality

Caller census (`grep` over `src`, `apps`, `examples` on the #19538 branch). The worker-side `resumeWindowDrag` methods of `TabSortZone`, the dashboard `Container` and `DragTarget` are SortZone hooks, not this addon method.

| Addon member | Reached from |
|---|---|
| Remote `parkWindowDrag`, `resumeWindowDrag`, `hasWindowDragOrphanRecovery`, `acknowledgeWindowDragOrphanRecovery`, `retireWindowDragOrphanRecovery` | Nothing |
| `recoverInvalidatedWindowDragPark`, `retryWindowDragParkRecovery`, `retainWindowDragOrphanRecovery`, `retryWindowDragOrphanRecovery`, `cleanupRetiredWindowDragOrphanRecovery`, `releaseWindowDragRouteOperation` | Only the members above |
| `promoteWindowDragParkRecovery` | Kept `resetDragState` and `startWindowDrag`, guarded by park state that only `parkWindowDrag` writes |
| `windowDragParked`, `windowDragParkedGeometry`, `windowDragParkRoute`, `windowDragParkRecovery`, the orphan-recovery map | State written only by the park path. `onDragMove`'s `!me.windowDragParked` branch is always taken. |

The PR re-proves each row against its own head before deleting it.

## The Fix

- Delete the parked-window-drag surface from the addon: its remote-method registrations, the state fields, and the parked branches of `resetDragState`, `startWindowDrag` and `onDragMove`.
- Delete the `DragDrop.spec` arms that pin it.
- Lower `buildScripts/util/file-size-baseline.json` with the shrink.

Kept: pointer-follow (`startWindowDrag`, the window branch of `onDragMove`), `setConfigs`, and everything the in-window and tear-out drags use. No behaviour change, because nothing reaches the surface.

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 §2.8.6 (#19533 amendment), whose pointer-path park text is already history.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No `parkWindowDrag`, `windowDragPark*`, park recovery or orphan recovery remains in `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs`, and a caller census at the PR head shows nothing referenced them.
- [ ] Pointer tear-out, re-entry and the native title-bar drop are unchanged: the kept `DragDrop.spec` arms, the unit suite, and the Workstation and dashboard e2e folders are green at their `dev` baseline.
- [ ] `file-size-baseline.json` follows the shrink.

## Out of Scope

- Any behaviour change.
- The worker-side dock (#19538).
- The native title-bar park (worker-side, kept).
- The class shape of the dock collaborators (#19540).

## Related

- #19538: removes the last callers; this ticket is blocked by its merge, because on `dev` `NativeVesselTransaction` still calls `resumeWindowDrag`.
- #19540: class conversion of the Dock window collaborators; touches no file of this ticket.
- #19533: the decision.
